name: 초라기
scene: At a dark marine research dock at blue hour, blue light reflected on wet stone, balanced standing card pose, face toward camera, both empty hands relaxed open beside her hips and clearly separate from her torso.

casual.scene: At an empty midnight lantern-festival rehearsal stage, making a small balanced dance step, one open hand at shoulder height and the other beside her waist; amber lanterns and indigo stage light, both hands fully readable.
casual.outfit: Original adult lantern-dancer event fashion: opaque lined sapphire halter bodice with secure neckline, gold waist belt, asymmetric short layered chiffon skirt over opaque fitted dance shorts. Bare shoulders, midriff and legs, tiny yellow teardrop earrings. No armor.

casual.scene: At a quiet mountain reservoir lookout at sunrise, side-on holding a compact camera below her face with both hands to compose a landscape photograph. Face unobstructed, cool mist and gold dawn rim light.
casual.outfit: Pale blue sleeveless cropped utility vest over a secure opaque navy sports top and high-waisted hiking shorts below frame. Bare arms and a narrow waist gap, tiny teardrop pendant, no armor.

casual.scene: In a dark aquarium maintenance gallery at afternoon, leaning slightly over a counter and using one hand to turn a small unlabelled lighting dimmer while the other rests open on the counter. Empty blue-lit glass tanks behind her; warm task light on face and hands.
casual.outfit: Opaque white sleeveless fitted work blouse with a secure V-neck, navy high-waisted straight shorts and a narrow yellow tool belt. Bare arms and legs, small yellow teardrop hair clip replacing armored headgear.
